entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:1
segments: ¶A good name [is] better than precious ointment, And the day of death than the day of one's birth;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:2
segments: Better to go to the house of mourning Than to go to the house of feasting, For that [is] the end of all men; And the living will take [it] to heart.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:3
segments: Sorrow [is] better than laughter, For by a sad countenance the heart is made better.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:4
segments: The heart of the wise [is] in the house of mourning, But the heart of fools [is] in the house of mirth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:5
segments: [It is] better to hear the rebuke of the wise Than for a man to hear the song of fools.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:6
segments: For like the crackling of thorns under a pot, So [is] the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:7
segments: ¶Surely oppression destroys a wise [man's] reason, And a bribe debases the heart.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:8
segments: The end of a thing [is] better than its beginning; The patient in spirit [is] better than the proud in spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:9
segments: Do not hasten in your spirit to be angry, For anger rests in the bosom of fools.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:10
segments: Do not say, "Why were the former days better than these?" For you do not inquire wisely concerning this.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:11
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] good with an inheritance, And profitable to those who see the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:12
segments: For wisdom [is] a defense [as] money [is] a defense, But the excellence of knowledge [is that] wisdom gives life to those who have it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:13
segments: Consider the work of God; For who can make straight what He has made crooked?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:14
segments: In the day of prosperity be joyful, But in the day of adversity consider: Surely God has appointed the one as well as the other, So that man can find out nothing [that will come] after him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:15
segments: I have seen everything in my days of vanity: There is a just [man] who perishes in his righteousness, And there is a wicked [man] who prolongs [life] in his wickedness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:16
segments: Do not be overly righteous, Nor be overly wise: Why should you destroy yourself?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:17
segments: Do not be overly wicked, Nor be foolish: Why should you die before your time?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:18
segments: [It is] good that you grasp this, And also not remove your hand from the other; For he who fears God will escape them all.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:19
segments: Wisdom strengthens the wise More than ten rulers of the city.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:20
segments: For [there is] not a just man on earth who does good And does not sin.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:21
segments: Also do not take to heart everything people say, Lest you hear your servant cursing you.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:22
segments: For many times, also, your own heart has known That even you have cursed others.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:23
segments: ¶All this I have proved by wisdom. I said, "I will be wise"; But it [was] far from me.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:24
segments: As for that which is far off and exceedingly deep, Who can find it out?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:25
segments: I applied my heart to know, To search and seek out wisdom and the reason [of things], To know the wickedness of folly, Even of foolishness [and] madness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:26
segments: And I find more bitter than death The woman whose heart [is] snares and nets, Whose hands [are] fetters. He who pleases God shall escape from her, But the sinner shall be trapped by her.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:27
segments: "Here is what I have found," says the Preacher, "[Adding] one thing to the other to find out the reason,

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:28
segments: Which my soul still seeks but I cannot find: One man among a thousand I have found, But a woman among all these I have not found.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:29
segments: Truly, this only I have found: That God made man upright, But they have sought out many schemes."
